value.rationale: For the earliest genuinely nontrivial three-one class, one can discard all substring compositions containing zero or one markers and retain exact unique reconstruction up to reversal for arbitrarily long words; the two-layer generating-function proof gives a direct decoder. This is a structural sparse-fragment sensing/reconstruction fact, not a tautology from general full-spectrum algorithms.
